stem:
Chetan follows what remains after most digested nutrients are absorbed in the small intestine. Undigested food, the large intestine and blood vessels in the small-intestine wall are part of the story.

What happens to the remaining undigested food?

options.text: It moves from the large intestine into the small intestine.
It moves into the large intestine.
The digested nutrients move into the large intestine after absorption.
The undigested food passes through the small-intestine wall into blood vessels.

teacher.key_rationale: Undigested food moves from the small intestine into the large intestine. It does not reverse direction, already-absorbed nutrients are not sent there as residue, and undigested food is not absorbed into blood.
